name: Make A Mark Day
summary: The team's flagship education day, now in its fourth year: two days of AI and coding workshops, careers talks and hands-on sessions at the AMR Technology Campus ahead of the British Grand Prix. Cognizant runs the future-careers discussions.

name: Trackside STEM outreach
summary: School and university sessions at Grand Prix locations, with show-car visits, team talks and workshops. The programme has run in the UK, China, Canada, the USA and Singapore, with Cognizant providing extra online STEM learning.

name: STEM Racing World Finals, Singapore
summary: At the STEM Racing World Finals in Singapore the team hosted the Canadian team with Bombardier and launched 'Unearth Your Greatness' with Maaden, reaching students from 35 countries.

name: Unearth Your Greatness (with Maaden)
summary: A multi-year youth programme with Maaden that supports STEM Racing through a free online learning platform, aiming to reach 100,000 students over three years.

name: Cognizant x AMF1 Gen-AI Ideathon
summary: Cognizant ran a global generative-AI Ideathon with the team for a second year running. University students tackle real team problems; the 2025 winners came from McGill University.

name: McGill University evening, Canadian Grand Prix
summary: During the Canadian Grand Prix weekend the team, Cognizant and Citi hosted panels at McGill University on where business and engineering meet in F1.

name: Aleto Foundation leadership programme
summary: A nine-month mentoring programme pairing university students from under-represented backgrounds with team members, with skills weeks and mock assessments.

name: Accelerate Women mentoring (with Arm)
summary: A six-month pilot pairing women mentors from Arm with women mentees in the team, covering leadership, technical confidence and career navigation.

name: AFBE-UK Transition Event
summary: Careers, CV and recruitment sessions at the campus for engineering students from under-represented ethnic backgrounds.

name: Para-canoe seat with Paddle UK
summary: Team composite engineers used CAD and prototyping to build a standard, on-demand seat that improves stability for para-canoe athletes across the Paddle UK fleet.

name: Racing Pride partnership
summary: Since 2021 the team has partnered with Racing Pride on LGBTQ+ inclusion, including trackside visits at the Canadian, Dutch and British Grands Prix and the Formula Student Diversity and Inclusion Award.

name: Neurodiversity Week with the ADHD Foundation
summary: An umbrella installation, drop-in lunches and training run by the team's Neurodiversity Employee Resource Group with the ADHD Foundation.

name: Miami school programme with Xerox
summary: Before the Miami Grand Prix the team and Xerox ran workshops and careers sessions at Booker T. Washington Senior High School, then hosted students at the circuit.

name: Manchester Metropolitan University induction festival
summary: The team brought the car and its engineers to an induction festival for science and engineering students.

name: The Grand Prix Trust Motorsport Industry Day
summary: A careers day at the Silverstone Wing where students met motorsport organisations; the team car was a focal point.

name: Children's hospital tours
summary: Jessica Hawkins and Jak Crawford took a car, steering wheel and helmet to children's hospitals in Aberdeen, Leeds, Liverpool, Birmingham and London.

name: Aramco student internships
summary: Mechanical engineering students sponsored by Aramco spend a summer with the team on sustainability projects, including the car's circularity metric.

name: Aspiring Mechanics Programme (with Valvoline)
summary: Hands-on motorsport training, product and financial support for young people from under-represented backgrounds who want to become mechanics.

name: Shanghai Foreign Language School STEM day
summary: Technical exhibits, demonstrations and a karting tutorial with Jessica Hawkins and Pedro de la Rosa for state-school students at the Chinese Grand Prix.

name: Rice University evening, United States Grand Prix
summary: Panels on careers, engineering and the business of motorsport for students from Rice, Texas Southern and the wider Houston community.

name: STEM and karting day in Oviedo
summary: Before the Spanish Grand Prix, the team and Aramco hosted STEM workshops and karting for Spanish students at the Museo y Circuito Fernando Alonso.

name: Milton Keynes Food Bank volunteering
summary: Team volunteers packed food parcels with Citi, JCB and Aston Martin Lagonda twice in 2024, alongside Citi's World Food Programme campaign on the car.

name: Carbon removal portfolio
summary: Community woodland restoration in Ethiopia, mangrove restoration in Kenya and concrete mineralisation in the USA, removing more carbon than the team's Scope 1 and 2 emissions.

name: Sustainable Aviation Fuel for air freight
summary: The team's first SAF investment, through F1's SAF programme and logistics partner Atlas Air, cut associated air-freight emissions by almost a third.

name: Campus bees and wild meadow
summary: Beehives, 72,000 m² of wild meadow and a 122% biodiversity net gain at the AMR Technology Campus.

name: Low-carbon paddock energy at European races
summary: F1's centralised trackside power (solar, HVO biofuel, renewable grid and batteries) at European rounds, which the team reports has cut paddock event-energy emissions by more than 90%.

name: Pit Lane Classroom: Singapore (illustrative)
summary: A race-week STEM session for Singapore secondary students, co-run with Cognizant volunteers: AI in race strategy, then a paddock walk. Modelled on Make A Mark Day.
notes: Illustrative concept for the demo. Not an announced AMF1 or Cognizant activity. Grounded in the real Make A Mark Day format and the verified Singapore STEM outreach history.

name: Marina Bay shoreline clean-up (illustrative)
summary: A fan and colleague volunteering slot on race Thursday, logging litter collected by category.
notes: Illustrative volunteering slot for the demo. Not an announced activity.

name: Women in engineering breakfast, Singapore (illustrative)
summary: A race-week mentoring breakfast for women studying engineering in Singapore, modelled on the Accelerate Women and International Women in Engineering Day formats.
notes: Illustrative concept for the demo. Not an announced activity.
